findings.title: Loss exposes wealth as a hidden partner
findings.claim: The destroyed yield makes visible that wealth had been carrying a partnership-like share in the owner's identity and future.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier is the first-person association form at 18:42:17. The wealth self-attribution at 28:78 and the correction of wealth as worldly adornment at 18:46 activate the general partnership branch, so the loss changes the focus from material accident into disclosure of where trust and future were invested.
findings.reader_payoff: The final confession can be perceived as a diagnosis of reliance, not only a statement made after property loss.
findings.containment: The ordinary association clause remains intact. Wealth is not made a literal divine partner, and the connections do not establish one exclusive causal history.

epistemic.reason: The branch-linked cross-run support is trusted; the wider connection rows supply exact target Arabic but omit target-side morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey, hak veya iş en az iki taraf arasında ortaktır ve taraflardan yalnız birine ait değildir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 28:78 attributes wealth to the owner's own knowledge, while 18:46 explicitly places wealth and children in worldly adornment.
branch_activations.activation: The focus association carrier contacts the wider self-attribution and correction of wealth, making partnership a relation of allocated trust rather than an isolated theological word.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The collapse reveals that the yield had been allowed to bear identity and future-security work that belonged elsewhere.
branch_activations.boundary: No literal equation of wealth with a divine partner and no exclusive lexical decision is being made.

findings.title: Collapse exposes the vacancy inside fullness

findings.reader_payoff: The ruined garden reads as a structural diagnosis of what its former fullness had been carrying.
findings.containment: The literal ruined garden remains intact. This does not claim that the root has only one sense or that every garden image in the supplied connections is the same scene.

epistemic.reason: The branch-linked publication is trusted; the connection targets provide exact Arabic images without target-side morphological analysis.
